## Problem and change

Explain the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue.

## Validation

List checks actually run and results. Include screenshots for visual changes.

## Compatibility and sources

Describe API changes, migration steps, dependencies, reused material and significant
AI assistance. Omit private infrastructure, credentials and personal data.

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and the DCO.
- [ ] My non-merge commits have my `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [ ] Tests/docs and generated templ Go are updated where applicable.
- [ ] I checked keyboard, narrow-screen and theme behavior for UI changes.
